description:
Goal

Make OutgoingInputEdges(E) own one immutable, replacement-safe full edge contribution derived from exact named authorities.

Signal

- ProductValue carries the complete edge set for E instead of Unit.
- Every RuntimeDemand and World fact read is recorded through the generic producer context.
- Equal re-production preserves generation.
- Added, changed, and withdrawn edges replace the prior full contribution and move generation only when the value changes.
- Consumers read the product value; no append-only session call-edge side effect is semantic authority.

Strategy

Derive the edge set locally from RuntimeDemand(E), LoweredBody, ActivationAnalyzed, ReturnType, EntryDispatch, and CallSiteSummary through exact reads. Return a stable immutable ordering. Migrate forward-edge consumers to the value or a purely derived replaceable index whose ownership and invalidation come from the product.

Removals

Remove ProductValue::Unit for this key, append-if-unique record_call_edge publication, stale outgoing memos surviving demand/fact movement, and custom DemandFactsCache stamping where the generic context owns the same reads.

Acceptance

Real-driver tests cover source fact/runtime-demand revisions, equal recomputation, full withdrawal, stable order, and no stale session edge. cargo test --lib and deny-warning clippy pass.
title: Return outgoing input edges as immutable replacement contributions
